leftEvidence.title: The heavens are torn open over Jesus

points.label: Event action and claim
points.left: Jesus comes from Nazareth, is baptized by John, and immediately sees the heavens torn open and the Spirit descending.
points.right: The Spirit immediately drives Jesus into the wilderness for forty days with Satan, wild animals, and angels.

points.label: Response and consequence
points.left: A voice directly addresses Jesus as beloved Son and names divine pleasure.
points.right: After John is arrested, Jesus comes to Galilee announcing fulfilled time and God’s near Kingdom.

payload.posture: Mark connects Spirit descent, Spirit driving, testing, John’s arrest, and Jesus’ announcement.

rightEvidence.role: From Jordan into testing and proclamation
rightEvidence.title: The Spirit drives Jesus into wilderness before proclamation

payload.tension: The same Spirit appears in descent and driving without the text treating those acts as identical.
payload.title: Torn heaven, driven wilderness, and proclamation
